name: rc-lead-finder
description: Finds people asking for pressure washing near you and drafts what to say. You post it.
long_description: Two tracks. Residential: searches public Facebook posts in your service area for people asking for pressure washing, filters out competitors advertising and posts you've already been mentioned in, scores what's left, and drafts a short comment tagging your page. Commercial: pulls freestanding small businesses in the area, drops corporate and big-footprint locations, finds a contact email, and drafts a first-touch note. Nothing is posted or emailed automatically — you copy a draft and send it yourself, which is both safer for your accounts and the reason it doesn't read as a bot. Searches run in the background rather than holding a tool call open, so a slow scrape never times out.
